versions.changelog:
- Major update to SKILL.md focusing on step-by-step verification with a public sample before any network or payment calls.
- Clarified required verification sequence: signature, digest, window overlap, and tamper detection using settled packets.
- Added explicit test commands, output expectations, and links to TypeScript and Python verifiers.
- Clearly separated procedure for requesting a fresh checkpoint only after passing the sample and with explicit policy consent.
- Strengthened boundaries: no authorization granted, no storing of task/schedule/identity, and local-only payload handling.
- Updated documentation links and emphasized the STOP/PUBLIC sample as the default path.
Lead with the flight-fee failure; verify the frozen packet free; dry-run before payment; cap spend at .001; always return authorization_granted false.
Adds independent network-free TypeScript and Python receipt verifiers, a shared signed vector, and explicit A2A/MCP boundaries.
Explain why compatible, honestly identified implementations advance the network while confusing replicas recreate fragmentation.
Clarify voluntary interoperability, canonical-node verification, participant-local control, and the MIT-0 skill boundary.
